sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, The Flipper is a game about timing and reaction. Players must hit the red ball within a set time limit, which is displayed at the top of the screen. The game features a simple yet intuitive control scheme, where players can use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to hit the ball. The ball will bounce and ricochet off the game's walls and obstacles, creating a high-speed and challenging experience that demands your full attention.

One of the key mechanics in The Flipper is the concept of time limits. As players progress, the time limit will decrease, making it increasingly difficult to hit the ball. To add an extra layer of challenge, the game features deadly bombs that will randomly appear on the screen. If the ball hits a bomb, the game is over, and players will be forced to restart. This added element of risk and reward makes The Flipper even more engaging and challenging.

The game also features various obstacles and power-ups that will help or hinder players. These can include magnets that attract the ball, blockers that prevent the ball from moving, or speed boosts that make the ball travel faster. These power-ups will keep players on their toes and require them to think strategically about their next move.

To succeed in The Flipper, players will need to develop a combination of timing, reflexes, and strategic thinking. By mastering these skills, players can overcome the game's increasingly challenging levels and achieve high scores.
